what: Attempted full checkerboard run with --train-encoders on the Apple M4 laptop (24 GB unified memory); stopped by hand
reason_stopped: Unified memory ran out mid-run: macOS swap reached 15.0 of 16.4 GB and steps slowed from 6-17 s to 96-135 s; the remaining 135 steps would have taken over 4 hours.
see_also: outputs/m4/tune/checkerboard_encoders_timing.json (a clean 5-step timing run: median 36.7 s/step, 17.9 GB peak)
